title: The Effect of Interaction between Active Learning Strategies and Cognitive Style on Reducing EFL Learners' Reading Anxiety
reason: Two-group classroom experiment on reading anxiety by strategy and cognitive style (tolerance of ambiguity), both measured by self-report scales. No LMS-measurable indicator or activity product is related to any outcome or construct.

extraction.n_quote: the researcher adopted a quantitative experimental design involving 72 learners assigned to two experimental groups
extraction.outcome_or_construct: reading anxiety (FLRAS); cognitive style tolerance/intolerance of ambiguity (EFLTIAS)
extraction.notes: eta2 and d values are pre-post strategy effects on self-reported anxiety, not indicator-outcome relations.
